name: Raif payment
author: Raiffeisen Ru

sections.description:
Этот WordPress плагин позволяет Woocommerce совершать платежи через Райффайзен Банк
Плагин зависит от Woocommerce 3

External services

This plugin connects to an API to show payment gateway page and process payment by Payment System or Fast Payment System. It accepts payment information and sends it to Raiffeisenbank acquiring processing system to proceed with payment. This plugin is provided by JSC Raiffeisenbank: payment agreement (cards), payment agreement (FPS), privacy policy.

Source code of minified files

assets/payment.min.js and assets/payment.min.css – https://github.com/Raiffeisen-DGTL/ecom-sdk-javascript, https://pay.raif.ru/pay/sdk/v2/payment.styled.js
